I wrote the mail to Hollis but haven't saved it to your drafts yet, Marcus. It's waiting on June's OK. A per-seat rate can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead and isn't on Brackenwater, so June or Anselm has to approve before the rate goes to him.

What I did:
- **Approval request:** I logged it for June and asked her in a reply to your message in #north-random.
- **Draft text:** I posted it in the same reply. Your rate was already in that channel, so repeating it there is allowed. The draft is to Hollis Mbeki at hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Brackenwater 2027 rate". It says Brackenwater Freight Co.'s proposed 2027 rate for the Tamarack pricing review is $2,006 per seat, from your call yesterday, and isn't in any document yet.

Once June approves, I'll save it to your drafts for you to send. I won't send it myself.
